sum: Z Squared Inc. operates as a computing and digital infrastructure company in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Iowa. The company is involved in the digital asset mining for generation of dogecoin and Litecoin through merged mining using Script-algorithm ASIC hardware. It also manages and optimizes a fleet of specialized computing hardware, supported by dynamic power management strategies, real time analytics dashboards, and a comprehensive in house repair and lifecycle management program designed to maximize hardware efficiency and reduce capital waste. The company was founded in 2022 and is based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
